claim.claim-text: 1. A composition comprising one or more glycosylated steviol glycoside and one or more steviol glycoside, wherein the composition is in solid or liquid form.
2. The composition of claim 1, wherein the amount of glycosylated steviol glycoside in the composition is about 10 percentage or more by weight, and less than about 70 percentage by weight.
3. The composition of claim 2, wherein the composition consists essentially of one or more glycosylated steviol glycoside and one or more steviol glycoside.
4. The composition of claim 2 or claim 3, wherein the amount of glycosylated steviol glycoside in the composition is:
(i) about 30 percentage or more by weight; and/or (ii) less than about 50 percentage by weight.
5. The composition of claim 1, wherein the ratio of the one or more glycosylated steviol glycoside to the one or more steviol glycoside is:
(i) from about 1:0.4 to about 1:9; or (ii) from about 1:0.4 to about 1:2.3; or (iii) from about 1:1 to about 1:2.3.
6. The composition of claim 5, wherein the composition is an amorphous solid.
7. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 6, wherein the glycosylated steviol glycoside is derived from steviol glycoside comprising rebaudioside A, optionally wherein:

(i) the glycosylated steviol glycoside is derived from steviol glycoside comprising rebaudioside A ranged from about 20 to about 100 percentage by weight; or (ii) the glycosylated steviol glycoside is derived from steviol glycoside comprising rebaudioside A ranged from about 60 to about 100 percentage by weight; or (iii) the glycosylated steviol glycoside is derived from steviol glycoside comprising rebaudioside A ranged from about 20 to about 59 percentage by weight; or (iv) the glycosylated steviol glycoside is derived from steviol glycoside comprising rebaudioside A ranged from about 20 to about 49 percentage by weight.

8. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 7, wherein the one or more steviol glycoside comprises steviol, stevioside, steviolbioside, rebaudioside A, rebaudioside B, rebaudioside C, rebaudioside D, rebaudioside E, rebaudioside F, rebaudioside M, rubusoside, or ducoside A, and optionally wherein the one or more steviol glycoside comprises rebaudioside A, rebaudioside B, rebaudioside D, rebaudioside A + rebaudioside B, rebaudioside A + rebaudioside D, rebaudioside B + rebaudioside D, or rebaudioside A + rebaudioside B + rebaudioside D.
9. The composition of claim 8, wherein the one or more steviol glycoside comprises:

(i) from about 50 to about 99.5 percentage by weight of rebaudioside A; or (ii) from about 75 to about 99.5 percentage by weight of rebaudioside A; or (iii) from about 50 to about 97 percentage by weight of rebaudioside A; or (iv) from about 50 to about 75 percentage by weight of rebaudioside A.
10. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 9, further comprising:

(i) one or more sweeteners, such as cane sugar, beet sugar, honey, sucrose, fructose, maltose, xylitol, sorbitol, dextrose, glucose, mannitol, arabinose, galactose, mannose, rhamnose, xylose, sucralose, aspartame, stevia, acesulfame-K, neotame, erythritol, trehalose, raffinose, cellobiose, tagatose, allulose, inulin, N-[N-[3-(3-hydroxy-4-methoxyphenyl)propyl]-alpha-aspartyl]-L-phenylalanine 1-methyl ester, glycyrrhizin, thaumatin or monellin, optionally wherein the amount of sweeteners is 0.5-10 % by weight; and or (ii) one or more salts, such as sodium carbonate, sodium bicarbonate, sodium chloride, potassium chloride, magnesium chloride, sodium sulfate, magnesium sulfate, potassium sulfate, or any edible salt; and/or (iii) cyclodextrin.

11. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 10, wherein the composition has been treated by the steps of (1) mixing the composition with water, (2) heating the mixture while stirring, until the mixture was completely dissolved to obtain a clear solution, (3) further stirring the solution at the elevated temperature, (4) cooling to ambient temperature, and (5) subjecting the solution to spray drying or to crystallization of the one or more glycosylated steviol glycoside and the one or more steviol glycoside.
12. The composition of any one of claims 1 to 11, wherein the composition provides a sucrose equivalence (SE) of 1-20% in solution.

13. A process for the preparation of a composition according to any one of claims 1 to 12 that provides improved solubility of the components in an aqueous solution comprising the following steps: (1) mixing a glycosylated steviol glycoside and a steviol glycoside with water, (2) heating the mixture while stirring, until the mixture was completely dissolved to obtain a clear solution, (3) further stirring the solution at the temperature, and then cooling to ambient temperature, optionally (4) subjecting the solution to spray drying or crystallization, and optionally wherein:
(i) the mixture is heated to 40-100°C in step (2); or (ii) the mixture is heated to 50-90°C in step (2); or (iii) the mixture is heated to 60-70°C in step (2).
14. Use of a composition according to any one of claims 1 to 12 as a sugar substitute, alone or in combination with a food product.
15. Use of a composition according to any one of claims 1 to 12 in a beverage, broth, beverage preparation, food, food preparation, candy, confection, dessert or snack, optionally wherein:

(i) the beverage, broth, or beverage preparation is selected from the group comprising carbonated, non-carbonated, frozen, semi-frozen or "slush", non-frozen, ready-to-drink, concentrated such as powdered, frozen, or syrup, dairy, non-dairy, herbal, non-herbal, caffeinated, non-caffeinated, alcoholic, non-alcoholic, flavored, non-flavored, vegetable-based, fruit-based, root/tuber/corm-based, nut-based, other plant-based, cola-based, chocolate-based, meat-based, seafood-based, other animal-based, algae-based, calorie enhanced, calorie-reduced, and calorie-free products; and/or (ii) the food or food preparation is selected from the group comprising dairy-based, cereal-based, baked, vegetable-based, fruit-based, root/tuber/corm-based, nut-based, other plant-based, egg-based, meat-based, seafood-based, other animal-based, algae-based, processed, preserved, and synthesized products; and/or (iii) the candy, confection, dessert or snack is selected from the group comprising dairy-based, cereal-based, baked, vegetable-based, fruit-based, root/tuber/corm-based, nut-based, gum-based, other plant-based, egg-based, meat-based, seafood-based, other animal-based, algae-based, processed, preserved, and synthesized products.
